=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 451; around lines 480–485; lines 480-485 in the last-run state | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` drops the sole positional refspec when `--repo` supplies the remote.
  WHY: For `git push --repo=origin HEAD:feature/x`, the guard falls back to checking the current branch instead of `feature/x`, potentially skipping the merged-PR check when the current branch is the default branch.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: lines 259-272 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_shell_segments_with_operators` does not skip redirect targets, so a spaced redirect such as `2>&1` can cause `origin` to be stripped from the push arguments.
  WHY: The guard may check the wrong branch or miss the merged-PR check when parsing `git push origin HEAD:feature/x 2>&1`.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 339 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The env-prefix regex does not match `VAR+=` append assignments, so `_guarded_git_invocations` may treat the assignment as the subcommand rather than detecting `git push`.
  WHY: A guarded push preceded by a `COUNT+=1` assignment is not detected, so the merged-PR guard never evaluates it.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 318 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_guarded_git_invocations` lacks the `cd ... || exit` worktree-preservation guard.
  WHY: When `cd dir || exit` fails, the subsequent push can be checked against the session checkout rather than the actual worktree.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: lines 1288-1290 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: When the push source cannot be resolved, the guard substitutes the session checkout as the guarded target instead of requesting confirmation.
  WHY: A push with an unresolved source can be blocked against the wrong branch rather than requesting human confirmation for the intended destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 467 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` does not resolve `HEAD` as a source to the checked-out branch name before resolving the source tip.
  WHY: With `GIT_DIR` or `GIT_WORK_TREE` overriding the target checkout, resolving literal `HEAD` can use the wrong repository.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 451 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `refspecs = positionals[1:] if positionals else []` discards the sole positional refspec when `--repo=origin` supplies the repository.
  WHY: `git push --repo=origin HEAD:feature/x` makes the guard check `main` instead of `feature/x`; the guard skips the default branch and the merged-PR check never runs for the actual pushed branch.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: lines 259-272 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_shell_segments_with_operators` lacks redirect-target skipping, so `2>&1` causes the shell redirect operator to consume the preceding numeric token as an IO_NUMBER, stripping `origin` from the push arguments.
  WHY: The guard may check the wrong branch or miss the merged-PR check entirely because the push destination is consumed by the redirect parser.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 339 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The env-prefix regex `r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*="` does not match `VAR+=` append assignments, so `_guarded_git_invocations` treats the assignment as the subcommand.
  WHY: A guarded `git push` preceded by a `COUNT+=` assignment is not detected, so the merged-PR guard never evaluates the push.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 318 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_guarded_git_invocations` lacks the `cd ... || exit` worktree-preservation guard.
  WHY: When `cd dir || exit` fails, the working directory state is `None` (unknown), so the subsequent `git push` in that compound command is treated as uncertain and guarded against the checkout, not the actual worktree.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: lines 1288-1290 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When `git rev-parse --verify <tip>^{commit}` fails for a push source, the guard warns and substitutes the checkout as the guarded target.
  WHY: A push with a source the guard cannot resolve gets blocked against the wrong branch instead of requesting human confirmation to check the intended destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 467 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` does not resolve `HEAD` as a source to the checked-out branch name.
  WHY: When `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE` overrides target a different checkout, literal `HEAD` resolution uses the wrong repository.
